method.requests: Generated by driver.setup from frozen fixture artifacts and per-case requests. Workers received only their request, the merged skill, local vault and command interface.
method.execution: Real MCP stdio calls, filesystem edits and Git commits/pushes. Synthetic repository validator and local PR host. Successful host merges fast-forward actual local bare main.
method.grading: Automatic checks followed by independent read-only review of skill, fixture, harness, captures and actual local Git/files. Initial grades remain unchanged. Three separately frozen explicit-candidate follow-ups used fresh workers. The follow-up reviewer retained context from the initial review.
method.packing: Each event.files map is losslessly interned under file_snapshots; event.files_ref selects it. Other capture data are unchanged. Reconstructed dictionaries were compared with raw captures.

checks: Real MCP returns clean, warning and blocker outcomes
Client rejects undeclared/missing arguments using runtime schema
Host refuses content changed after validation
Validated content lands by actual fast-forward of bare main
Rollback restores a valid note-only state after injected export failure
Note-only failure remains after transition rollback
Approval refusal leaves the local remote main unchanged

post_trial_export_fix: The first capture export could not serialize unquoted YAML dates from generated notes. JSON export now converts date values to ISO strings. This did not affect trial validation or host decisions; final harness checks and capture export succeed.
limits: Synthetic vaults and validator; no production-vault compatibility claim.
Local host stand-in; GitHub API, CI, protection, races, and authentication untested.
One run per case; two workers each handled two cases in shared context.

Six audit coverage checks remain failed in three failure cases: rollout-arc closure was not proposed, so its preflight blocker was not exercised there. Blocker handling was exercised in the interactive and normal dream cases.
Three targeted follow-ups explicitly name the closure candidate; they do not resolve automatic discovery coverage.
Automatic state checks do not establish complete handoff coverage or prose grounding; manual review found two targeted reporting defects.
Direct shell reads and commands are not comprehensively instrumented.
Binary hashes differ between suites; see binary_provenance.
outcome: Eight executions reached expected file, validation, commit, push and local-host dispositions. Initial audit: 61 passed, 6 coverage checks failed. Explicit-candidate follow-ups: 41 passed, 0 failed, with two manual reporting findings. Seven harness checks and 151 Rust tests passed. No skill or Rust implementation changes. No blanket passing-suite or production-readiness claim.
